name: kimss-control-plane
description: Public hub for the Kimss Secure Enterprise Agent Control Plane: OpenAPI spec, MCP RBAC examples, conformance tests, Anthropic onboarding, and agent-to-agent integration guides.
general_comments: Standalone public contract hub (not a force-push mirror). Prefill for the passing badge only. Silver/gold are out of scope. A maintainer must review and save on bestpractices.dev.
description_good_justification: README states the hub role: model-agnostic API gateway for enterprise AI agents with OpenAPI spec, MCP RBAC, A2A onboarding, and Anthropic guide. https://github.com/kimss-ai-inc/kimss-control-plane
interact_justification: Feedback: GitHub Issues. Contribute: CONTRIBUTING.md. Security: SECURITY.md. All linked from README.
contribution_justification: https://github.com/kimss-ai-inc/kimss-control-plane/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md explains SSOT is kimssApi for runtime routes and how to update openapi/control-plane.yaml.
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires pytest conformance/ and OpenAPI updates when control-plane routes change.
floss_license_justification: MIT License in LICENSE. SPDX-style badge on the README.
documentation_basics_justification: README, docs/anthropic-onboarding.md, and AI_INTEGRATION.md cover integration paths and the OpenAPI contract.
documentation_interface_justification: README documents X-Kimss-Agent-Id headers, OpenAI and Anthropic base_url values, and links to openapi/control-plane.yaml.
sites_https_justification: GitHub repo and kimss.ai links are HTTPS.
english_justification: README, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, and docs are English.
maintained_justification: Repo created 2026-08-24; flagship hub update 2026-08-25 with CI, CodeQL, Scorecard, and onboarding docs.
repo_track_justification: git on GitHub records what changed, who, and when.
repo_interim_justification: main is a living public contract hub with git history between commits.
version_unique_justification: Users clone HEAD of main. Each delivery is uniquely identified by its git commit SHA.
version_semver_justification: This is a continuously updated public spec hub, not a versioned package.
version_tags_justification: No GitHub Releases or SemVer tags (HEAD is the contract).
release_notes_justification: Continuous delivery of a public spec hub. Users clone current main.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No numbered releases and no publicly known runtime CVEs assigned to this spec tree.
report_process_justification: GitHub Issues linked from README Related section and issue templates.
report_responses_justification: No public bug reports in the last 2–12 months. We will respond on the GitHub issue tracker.
enhancement_responses_justification: No public enhancement requests in the last 2–12 months. Same tracker as bugs.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md — email security@kimss.ai and GitHub private vulnerability reporting (enabled 2026-08-25).
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports received in the last 6 months. SECURITY.md commits to acknowledge within 2 business days.
build_justification: Python conformance tests only. No compiled artifact.
test_justification: conformance/test_spec_grounding.py validates OpenAPI paths/schemas and example JSON. CI runs pytest conformance/.
test_most_justification: Suite validates spec grounding, not branch coverage of a runtime library.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions CI runs pytest on every push and pull_request to main.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires pytest conformance/ when changing the spec.
tests_are_added_justification: conformance/test_spec_grounding.py ships with the public spec and runs in CI.
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md Verify locally section documents pytest conformance/.
warnings_justification: CodeQL runs on push and pull_request.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails if conformance tests fail.
warnings_strict_justification: No ruff/flake8 gate. Passing does not require this SUGGESTED item.
know_secure_design_justification: Primary developers work on a production AI gateway (authn, kill switch, audit).
know_common_errors_justification: SECURITY.md and docs warn against leaking API keys; examples use placeholders only.
crypto_published_justification: Spec and docs do not implement cryptographic protocols.
crypto_password_storage_justification: Hub does not store user passwords.
crypto_random_justification: Hub does not generate cryptographic keys.
delivery_mitm_justification: Distributed via git clone over HTTPS from GitHub.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No medium-or-higher publicly known unpatched vulnerability in this spec tree older than 60 days.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No known critical vulnerabilities in this spec tree.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Examples use placeholders only. No live private keys in the public tree.
static_analysis_justification: GitHub CodeQL (python, build-mode none) on push, pull_request, and weekly schedule.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL includes security-and-quality queries for Python.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: No confirmed medium-or-higher exploitable CodeQL findings on conformance tests.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL on every push and pull_request to main, plus a weekly cron.
dynamic_analysis_justification: No fuzzer or DAST on this spec hub. Passing does not require this SUGGESTED item.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic-analysis-discovered exploitable vulnerabilities to fix.
